title: Remark about Federal Councillor Elisabeth Baume-Schneider
description: On the federal election Sunday of 22 October 2023, while criticising asylum policy to journalists, Grossen described SP Federal Councillor Elisabeth Baume-Schneider as 'not the brightest candle on the cake' ("nicht die hellste Kerze auf der Torte"). The comment drew criticism from across the political spectrum. Grossen subsequently retracted and apologised, saying he had meant to criticise her asylum policy rather than her as a person and attributing the remark to fatigue after his party's electoral setback.

title: Questions over dual roles as energy-industry lobbyist and legislator
description: Grossen has faced media questions about potential conflicts of interest arising from his simultaneous roles as president of the e-mobility (Swiss eMobility) and solar (Swissolar) industry associations, owner of building-technology and smart-energy companies, and a National Councillor sitting on energy and economic matters. Asked about this 'double mandate', he has described himself as primarily an 'Überzeugungstäter' (someone acting out of conviction) and argued that environmental protection and the economy must be reconciled. No wrongdoing has been alleged; his mandates are publicly declared in the parliamentary register of interests.
